question: Will New Zealand beat Fiji by more than 12 points in their 2026 Rugby League World Cup pool match?

calls.reasoning: I found no market for this match. The Australia v Fiji tip line is -44.5. New Zealand lost to Australia by only 2 and rate within about a score of them, which implies a fair NZ-Fiji line of roughly -30 to -38. Assuming a margin SD of about 14, covering 12.5 is around 90-95%. I shaded that down because I could not observe the line directly, Fiji will be motivated in what is probably a qualification decider, and recent NZ-Fiji knockout games were close (24-18 in 2022, 2-4 in 2017). Fiji are without Kikau and Kamikamica.
